author: dcrising2002
body:
I love avicus because of the community, staff and mini games. I always have a smile on my face when I join a mini game, knowing it is unique and fun. Also, the community has a lot of positives and I feel, for the first time in 5 months, great here.
Thank you avicus

TheoLucy
